title: AMD action: is-patient
description: Boolean probe: does this string match at least one AMD patient name? Same lookuppatient wire action as lookup_patient, but match rows are dropped in the handler. Returns is_patient, count, exactmatch, mode, matched_as (last|first|null). No query echo, no ids, no names, no DOB. Use for PHI-free name detection; use lookup_patient to resolve a patient.

name.description: The string to test as a patient name. Punctuation is stripped and it is upper-cased before the search.

exactmatch.description: Exact last-name match (default). False allows AMD prefix matching.

mode.description: last: test as a last name (one AMD call). both: on no last-name hit, also test as a first name via the raw ',NAME' query (second call; unverified live).
